model.action_definition: current priority request/hold indicator; future policy remains observational
limitations: Observational policy data does not identify causal action effects
Bounds fallback checks feature ranges, not all distribution shifts
Seed holdout does not establish unseen-city or unseen-route generalization
Prediction improvement alone does not establish faster ambulance journeys

model_decision_audit.limitation: Same observed AI trajectory; request differences do not establish causal travel-time benefit.

limitations: Development runs and a single matched example are not a population benchmark.
Actuated baseline uses the common corridor occupancy guard; it has no priority requests.
OSM signals and geometry are inferred; no field-calibrated pedestrian demand.
The controller adapter is an emulator; no physical signals are connected.
